intent_snapshot.goal: A Lane batch start refuses only when the coordinator's runtime and the Lane Executor's runtime disagree on runtime contract identifiers; a loaded plugin build that merely differs byte-wise from the workspace plugin stays a non-blocking status warning, a claude-code Lane Executor loads the coordinator's own plugin, and the refusal carries a recovery action that names the runtime mismatch (Spec docs/specs/lane-runtime-contract-check.spec.md D1-D4).

acceptance.assertion: In a plugin-source workspace whose dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs differs from the loaded build while runtime_contracts.json identifiers match, laneRuntimeContractRefusal returns null and a new lane startBatch reaches batch_state running; an executor_runtime whose task_record differs still refuses batch_runtime_contract_mismatch naming both manifests and creates no batch record. Done looks like: the former byte-skew refusal case in tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts now starts, and the contract-mismatch case still rejects.

For an ordinary plugin-source checkout with a differing loaded build, pluginSourceSkewWarning still returns loaded_plugin_differs_from_workspace with the reload guidance and projectTaskStatus still lists it in warnings, while laneRuntimeContractRefusal for the same checkout and loaded build returns null. Done looks like: tests/lane-executor-status-guidance.test.ts asserts the warning and the null refusal.

A Lane session opened for a claude-code Executor passes --plugin-dir followed by the coordinator's runtimeClaudePluginDir() in its hostArgs, alongside the profile's --model and --effort; a pi Executor's hostArgs carry no --plugin-dir. Done looks like: the requested-executor-profile cases in tests/lane-sessions.test.ts assert both argv shapes.

The batch reason table maps batch_runtime_contract_mismatch to a rejected state whose recovery_action tells the user to load the same Immune-Brain runtime contracts in the coordinator Host and the Lane Executor Host and retry in the current Host, with no mention of a conflicting branch; batch_run_rejected keeps its existing text. Done looks like: the reason-table expectations in tests/unattended-batch-run.test.ts.
